summary: Tested 4 amenity booking features + 4 bug fixes. All 13 backend pytest cases PASS against the public preview URL: today/tomorrow date restriction, consecutive-day same-slot block, edit booking (PUT /api/bookings/{id}) with date+peak revalidation, and peak-hours 18:00-20:00 30-min rejection (including the 17:30+30=18:00 edge case where slot_end == peak_start should pass). Static verification of all 5 bug-fix files passes: VillaManagement.jsx, VillaNumberModal.jsx, EmailVerificationBanner.jsx, VerifyEmail.jsx, Login.jsx all import getBackendUrl from ../utils/api and have no local definition; service-worker.js has CACHE_VERSION = 'v4'; backend/villas.py uses load_dotenv(Path(__file__).parent / '.env'). Frontend BookingCalendar.jsx correctly implements today/tomorrow buttons, editingBooking prop pre-fill, peak slot blocking with auto-switch to 60min, and proper data-testid attributes. MyBookings.jsx shows Edit button with canEditBooking() guard and re-uses BookingCalendar in edit mode. Public pages (/login, /amenities) load cleanly without console pageerrors.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/bookings.py is ~590 lines and mixes amenity bookings + clubhouse staff + PDF reports; consider splitting into bookings_user.py + bookings_staff.py to stay under the 700-line guideline as more features are added.

_check_consecutive_day_slot uses an exact match on duration_minutes — so booking a 60-min slot at 10:00 today and a 30-min slot at 10:00 tomorrow would NOT trip the consecutive-day check. If product intent is 'same time slot' regardless of duration, drop duration from the query; if it's strictly 'identical slot', current behavior is fine. Worth confirming with PM.

Edit booking does NOT enforce a cancellation/edit cutoff window (e.g. no edits within 1 hour of start). Today's check only blocks 'past' bookings via booking_dt < now, so a user can edit a 10:00 booking at 09:59. Consider adding a buffer.

BookingCalendar.jsx PUT uses `${getAPI()}/bookings/{id}` which is fine, but on edit the consecutive-day backend error message references the OTHER day's date; the frontend just toasts the raw detail — acceptable but could be styled better.
test_credentials: Used the inject-session approach from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: temp 'testtok_*' session for troa.systems@gmail.com (admin). Cleaned up in fixture teardown.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates bookings on TODAY/TOMORROW for amenity 69bec999-30e1-4127-845d-dc6dff3e2057 (Sports Courts) under troa.systems@gmail.com. Auto-cleaned via autouse fixture before/after every test and at session teardown. No leftover seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_24: All 4 booking features and 4 bug fixes are functionally correct at API + static-frontend level. The new test file /app/backend/tests/test_booking_features.py is a reusable regression suite — re-run with `pytest backend/tests/test_booking_features.py -v`.
